run.name: Chemours Co
run.title: CP-OS host session (CC)
run.summary: Chemours is a leveraged, cyclical credit with adequate near-term liquidity, falling debt and cost-shared legacy liabilities, but its cash flow is claimed by multi-year PFAS settlements and book equity is thin. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Debt principal 3,872 and cash 698 at 2026-09-30 over LTM Adjusted EBITDA 747, calculated as 750 plus 616 less 619 (10-Q Q3 page:133). Management prints approximately 4.3x on 744 (release page:13). Unrestricted cash only; restricted cash of 103 excluded.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. Adjusted EBITDA 750 over cash paid for interest, net of amounts capitalized, 251 (10-K page:163).

cash.basis: Cash. Availability net of 47 of letters of credit (10-Q Q3 page:149), measured before 2026-10-07 when a 220 tranche matured; whether it was extended is not stated. 410 of the cash is held by foreign subsidiaries (page:149).

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Covenant headroom, legal capacity and current cash interest cover cannot be tested from the supplied sources.
CP-1 main limitation: Adjusted EBITDA is not printed as a consolidated filing total, 2026 cash interest is not printed, and covenant headroom cannot be calculated.
